summary.text: A silent nighttime study of rain on a bus window as blurred city lights slide past outside.

description.text: At night, rain-soaked glass fills the tall vertical frame in close medium detail. The glass has a cool, blue-black tone. Silver beads of water gather across the lower half, with finer droplets scattered above. Beyond the pane, city lights are soft and out of focus, smeared into pale amber and white shapes that slide slowly sideways as the bus moves. One large droplet trembles, draws smaller drops into itself, then breaks into a wavering trail that crawls down the glass. A passing light flares faintly across the wet surface, briefly revealing tiny scratches and a thin film of condensation, before the reflection fades. The scene holds a patient, quiet attention on the changing water and the drifting lights.
A soft patter of rain taps against the glass, underlaid by a low bus engine hum and muffled traffic.
Silver droplets cling to the dark window glass, with blurred city lights beyond.
A large droplet gathers smaller beads and begins to tremble.
The merged drop breaks into a wavering streak and crawls downward.
A passing light flares softly across the wet surface, then fades.
The camera holds a static shot.

The view widens to show more of the rain-streaked window and its dark frame. Long, broken rain lines lengthen and fork across the foreground glass, while the city beyond resolves into blurred bands of streetlights, shop signs, and building windows sliding horizontally past. A few bright points bloom and stretch into short streaks. The focus eases from the nearest droplets to the moving lights outside, so the water becomes a soft veil and the nighttime streets become the subject. Inside the bus, faint reflections and a shallow strip of dark interior edge the pane, giving the window physical depth without adding people or text. Fresh rain continues to trail down as the light trails drift, keeping the same steady rhythm to the end.
Steady rain continues against the bus, mixed with a muffled engine drone and distant traffic.
The framing opens from a tight view of droplets to a wider view of the window and moving city.
Focus shifts from the nearest droplets to blurred streaks of streetlights and building lights beyond the pane.
Fresh rain trails lengthen and fork across the foreground glass.
The blurred city lights continue sliding horizontally past the dark, wet glass.
The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.
